Search Catalogue Contact unit Circulation Desk Service status Published Overview Circulation services support access to print and related library materials for eligible KIU users. Users should present a valid KIU identity document and observe loan periods, renewal conditions and recall notices. Intended users Registered KIU students, academic staff, administrative staff and other approved library users. How to access this service Confirm your borrower status, search the catalogue, locate the item, present it at the circulation desk and keep track of return dates through library guidance. Requirements Valid KIU identification and compliance with library borrowing rules. Related support Library staff can help you choose the correct service or route your request to the relevant unit.
